[[File:MorgukaiWarrior.jpg|thumb|250px|A Morgukai warrior with a cortosis staff]]
{{Quote|Surprise, Jeedai? Light not cut. Cortosis alloy, Jeedai. Ho!|[[Tsyr]] to [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 42">[[Star Wars (1998) 42|''Star Wars'' (1998) 42]]</ref>}}
The '''cortosis staff''' was a melee weapon produced by the [[Morgukai]] warriors&mdash;a sect of [[Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]]&mdash;for use in single combat against [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. The staff was laced with [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis ore]], a mineral naturally resistant to a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The top of the staff can emit a small plasma blade just like that of a lightsaber. The bottom of the staff featured a small but powerful electrical generator which not only powered the energy blade but could release powerful bursts of electrical energy on contact with an object. This allowed the staff to be an electrostaff, a lightstaff, and a lightspear all rolled in one.

The meter-long cortosis staff featured a small, electrical generator, similar to the [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaffs]] wielded by [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The staff could be used as a lethal spear as well as electro stun weapon, able to counter the advantage afforded by lightsaber-wielding opponents. Morgukai such as [[Tsyr]] and [[Bok]] carried such weapons, as did members of the [[Morgukai Shadow Army]] on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]].

[[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]] was thought to be the first Jedi to encounter a cortosis staff in battle, and was rendered unconscious by a strike from Tsyr's weapon during a fight on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] in [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]]. He later informed [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] of the details of the weapon, and asked her to report its existence to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].
